# Campfire Writing

> > Campfire Writing is a comprehensive creative writing platform combining distraction-free writing tools, advanced story planning, character development, worldbuilding features, and an integrated ebook marketplace for authors.

Campfire Writing provides fiction authors with an all-in-one suite of tools for writing, planning, worldbuilding, and self-publishing. The platform supports multiple export formats (DOCX, EPUB, PDF), offers desktop and mobile apps for offline writing, and features an interactive book discovery marketplace with reader bonus content.

## Key Topics

- Writing Software
- Story Planning
- Character Development
- Worldbuilding Tools
- Interactive Maps
- Self-Publishing Platform
- Manuscript Management
- Creative Writing
- Fiction Writing
- Ebook Marketplace
- Desktop & Mobile Apps
- Bonus Content
- 3 Act Structure
- Campfire Publishing

## Core Writing Tools

- [The Writing App That Inspires](https://campfirewriting.com/word-processor): Distraction-free writing editor with export to DOCX, EPUB, and PDF formats
- [Custom Novel Plotting Software for Fiction Authors](https://campfirewriting.com/story-planner): Advanced story planning supporting 3 Act, 7 Point, 27 Chapter, and Fichtean Curve structures
- [Best Character Building Software for Fiction Writers](https://campfirewriting.com/character-builder): Character development tool with Arcs, Relationships, and Notes modules

## Worldbuilding & Maps

- [#1 Worldbuilding Software to Make Interactive Fantasy Maps](https://campfirewriting.com/interactive-maps): Interactive fantasy map creation with Inkarnate Pro integration
- [Epic Worldbuilding Tools for Fiction Writers](https://campfirewriting.com/worldbuilding-tools): Comprehensive worldbuilding modules for Locations, Maps, Cultures, and Languages

## Platform & Apps

- [Campfire: Where Stories Come to Life](https://campfirewriting.com/write): Main Campfire platform for writing, worldbuilding, and self-publishing
- [Desktop and Mobile Apps | Campfire for Authors](https://campfirewriting.com/apps): Desktop and mobile applications for MacOS, Windows, and iOS with offline writing capability

## Self-Publishing & Bookshop

- [Book Publishing Platform with Built-in Formatting Tools](https://campfirewriting.com/self-publishing): Self-publishing platform with formatting tools and reader analytics
- [Campfire - Where Stories Come to Life](https://campfirewriting.com/explore): Book discovery and ebook marketplace with bonus content exploration
- [Free Reading App to Explore Books with Bonus Content](https://campfirewriting.com/reading-app): Free reading application for iOS and Android with bonus content and library features
- [Reading and Purchasing Books on Campfire](https://campfirewriting.com/book-pricing): Guide to book pricing, royalties, refunds, and bonus content distribution

## Pricing & Accounts

- [Campfire Pricing and Account Plans](https://campfirewriting.com/pricing): Subscription plans, lifetime licenses, and module pricing in USD, CAD, and AUD
- [Give the Gift of Campfire](https://campfirewriting.com/gifting): Gift cards and subscription gifting options for Campfire modules and tools
- [Campfire Bookshop Gift Cards - Campfire](https://campfirewriting.com/explore/gift-cards/purchase): Digital gift cards for Campfire Bookshop using wallet system
- [Campfire: Where Stories Come to Life](https://campfirewriting.com/profile/modules/manage): User account management and module redemption authentication
- [Campfire: Where Stories Come to Life](https://campfirewriting.com/profile/orders): User account login and order management dashboard
